x: Things got a little harder as the season progressed and we lost sprinter Marlon Dickson, vaulter Jamie Webb and 400 flat and hurdles man Jon Squirrell to the British League team but to be honest, this just gave some of the younger men a chance to show their mettle - and they grasped the chance.

Jon Squirrell was our nominated scorer in the 400m hurdles, the very first event, and his 56.4 was more than good enough to take top points but running as a non-scorer our second-claimer Ruben Tabares had already got home to clock 54.8, reducing the league record by 3 tenths.
Another fine run came from Junior Galley in the 'chase and others who regularly chalk up good points — and did it again — were Jon Squirrell in the long hurdle race and Jamie Webb in the 'vault.
